1. (Currently Amended): An immunogenic composition comprising: a modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type lb (BVDV-lb), __a veterinary-acceptable carrier, and a stabilizing agent__, and optionally an adjuvant.

3. (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising one or more of a parainfluenza virus Type 3 (PI3), a bovine respiratory syncytial virus (BRSV), a bovine herpes virus (BHV-1), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type la (BVDV-la), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type 2 (BVDV-2), or an infectious bovine rhinotracheitis (IBR) virus, or any combination thereof; or one or more viral-specific antigens obtained therefrom, wherein the composition is free of inactivated bacteria cultures.

4. (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising a modified, live IBRV, a modified, live BRSV, a modified, live BHV-1, a modified, live BVDV Type la, a modified, live BVDV Type 2, or a modified, live PI3, or a combination thereof, wherein the composition excludes inactivated bacteria cultures.

6. (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising an immunologically effective amount of at least a first antigen, wherein the composition is free of inactivated bacteria cultures.

12. (Currently Amended): The vaccine of claim 4, further comprising an immunologically-effective amount of at least one microbial pathogen-specific antigen, wherein the composition is free of inactivated bacteria cultures.
